foreach(_role server client)
  add_executable(pipe_tp_${_role}_bert_base pipe_tp_${_role}.cu)
  target_link_libraries(pipe_tp_${_role}_bert_base PRIVATE Phantom)
  target_include_directories(pipe_tp_${_role}_bert_base PUBLIC ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
  target_compile_definitions(pipe_tp_${_role}_bert_base PRIVATE ENCFORMER_M=128 ENCFORMER_D=768 ENCFORMER_H=12 ENCFORMER_D_FF=3072 ENCFORMER_NSLOTS=16384)
  set_target_properties(pipe_tp_${_role}_bert_base PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin)
endforeach()
